name: agentic-orbit-standalone
description: The map in a plain browser window: a small Node host that reads the same hook events the extension reads and serves the live page on loopback. Nothing here ships in the extension.

scripts.build: esbuild cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/server.js && esbuild test-entry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=out/test-entry.js && esbuild main.ts --bundle --outfile=out/web/bundle.js --format=iife && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('out/web', {recursive: true}); for (const f of ['index.html', 'main.css']) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'out/web/' + f); fs.mkdirSync('out/res', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('../vscode-extension/res/agentic-orbit-hook.js', 'out/res/agentic-orbit-hook.js')"
